append.detail: 2026-11-10 owner delegation: stays on the 2026-10-26 ruling, not applied. The live EXPLAIN uses the existing domain-prefix and Space indexes, the reply-alias unique bounds its FK lookup, and no application latency benefit is established, so a production migration (index and policy rewrite) buys nothing measurable and carries registration and apply cost under HYG-217. Future trigger unchanged: a representative authenticated workload or an FK-maintenance plan showing material avoidable cost. The row stays OPEN at its priority (HYG-161: only the iOS app build may be parked); it is a ruling with a future trigger, not a defect.
